name: TOPPAN Holdings Inc.
summary: TOPPAN Holdings Inc. develops solutions based on its printing technologies in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Information & Communication, Lifestyle & Industry, and Electronics. The Information & Communication segment offers securities in general, bankbooks, cards, business forms, catalogs, and other advertising and promotional printed materials, magazines, books, business process outsourcing, and other publications services. The Lifestyle & Industry segment provides soft packaging and paper containers, plastic moldings, inks, transparent barrier films, decorative sheets, wallpaper, and other building materials.
